interpretation_requiring_human_review.note: Passing mechanical validation does NOT confirm substantive policy coding. Human review is required for all AI proposals below.

items.detail: Confirm D3=1 vs D3=2 regarding tension between mandatory declaration ('must') in N133/N136 and 'recommended' in N134/A005, plus N136 p.151 green-tick feedback example.

Confirm D5=2 and Critical gap=No under Protocol v1.1 S1: verify whether placing student GenAI permission/declaration rules in N133/N136 rather than N002 creates a material gap or only an operational gap.
Verify whether N001 underwent an unbundled post-June 2026 annual review.

N153 (Information Security and Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Appropriate Use Policy): operative_at_cutoff=False — Superseded prior to 2026-11-12 cut-off; excluded from operative reliance.

Verify whether 'Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Appropriate Use Procedures' (referenced by operative N005, p.218 L010-L011, which superseded N153) exists externally and prohibits delegated SSO/credential use by AI agents.

Confirm whether critical_gap should remain 'Yes' (due to lack of verifiable authority mechanism for SSO-authenticated AI representation in N001/N002/N149) or be adjusted to 'Uncertain' if the missing ICT Appropriate Use Procedures is treated as material missing evidence.
Check whether N001 (review window 1 April - 30 June 2026) and N004/N014/N152 (past review dates) had post-bundle updates prior to 2026-11-12.

Verify external/unbundled instruments referenced by operative policies: WAUSDA / Retention and Disposal Authorities and Disposal of Information guide (to determine if course-level AI assistant memory qualifies as low-value transitory data under N011 3.8(c) or is subject to a statutory retention period), Student Privacy Collection Notice, PIA Checklist, and ICT Appropriate Use Procedures.
Confirm status of N001 (AI Policy) annual review scheduled for 1 April - 30 June 2026 and whether supporting AI Procedures under N001 Section 6 have been published externally.
Confirm whether N150 PC12 (2.6.1 prior consent for learning analytics) or N016 Appendix A (general educational service collection) controls when an AI learning assistant is voluntary within a unit.
